pr.title: Reconciliation: replace PaymentReconciliationLedgerEntryRepositoryAdapterImpl with the streaming ledger adapter, backfill 18.4M rows, and drop LegacyLedgerEntryMapper (RFC-0412)
pr.author: aleksandra-wisniewska-kowalczyk
pr.head: f00dfacecafebeef0000000000000000deadbeef
pr.body:
Closes #12846

This replaces the reconciliation ledger adapter. See https://northwind-industries-holdings.example.com/engineering/rfcs/2026/payments/reconciliation/RFC-0412-ledger-entry-repository-adapter-replacement-and-backfill-plan?version=7&reviewers=bartholomew.fitzgerald%40northwind-industries-holdings.example.com

| Service | Before (p99) | After (p99) | Rows backfilled | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| payments-reconciliation-ledger-entry-repository | 1,284 ms | 212 ms | 18,446,744 | bartholomew.fitzgerald@northwind-industries-holdings.example.com |

```
ERROR 2026-10-11T23:59:59.999Z [payments-reconciliation-ledger-entry-repository-adapter] LedgerEntryRepositoryAdapterImpl.reconcile(PaymentReconciliationLedgerEntryRepositoryAdapterImpl.java:4127) ConstraintViolation: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "ledger_entries_payment_id_reconciliation_window_idx"
```
